title: Shapeshift
description:
When you **transform into a beast you've encountered before**, describe your new shape, choose an adaptation below, and roll+WIS. If you encountered the beast before the game began, the GM may ask for details.
- fast & agile — 1d6 dmg #precise #hand #close
- mobile & acclimated — 1d4 dmg #hand, can fly, swim, or burrow
- small or camouflaged — 1 dmg #hand. You have **adv** to **Sneak Past**
- tough & strong — Armor 2, 1d8 dmg #hand #close

outcomes.text: It works and you gain the adaptation's benefits.
It works, but the GM will say what compels your instincts; pursue it now or mark a Condition to resist it.
It works, but you lose control over it for now; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

submoves.title: Note
submoves.description: While shapeshifted you can't communicate with anyone except other PCs. You can return to normal any time you're in control, but must always do so when the scene ends.
